description: Shared header of a DocumentEditor inspector panel (redesign DE-2.1): an optional decorative icon, the title as a heading whose id the panel region labels itself by (aria-labelledby), an optional subtitle, a host actions slot and a close (X) button that appears only when OnClose is bound. The close button is named by the localized TmDocumentEditor_Close string. Panels of phases 5-7 adopt it; the form pattern it sits above is the .tm-document-inspector-form CSS pattern. The companion form pattern is CSS-only (_document-editor-panels.css): .tm-document-inspector-form with __section / __section-toggle (aria-expanded) / __chevron (TmIcon chevron-down, rotates), __section-body, __field (the label sits beside the control while the panel body is wide enough and wraps above it when it is not - an intrinsic flex-wrap, no container query; --stacked keeps it above at any width), __label, __control, __suffix (units) and __segmented / __segmented-option (icon or icon + text); --embedded drops the frame and the shadow for a panel hosted inside the inspector. A field keeps the implicit label-wraps-control association.

parameters.name: Title
parameters.description: Panel title, rendered as the heading the panel region labels itself by (aria-labelledby).

parameters.name: TitleId
parameters.description: Id of the title heading. Set it when the host region needs a stable aria-labelledby target; when omitted a unique id is generated and readable through ResolvedTitleId.

parameters.name: Subtitle
parameters.description: Optional secondary line under the title (a count, a file name, a status).

parameters.name: Icon
parameters.description: Optional leading icon name. The icon is decorative and always aria-hidden.

parameters.name: HeadingLevel
parameters.description: Heading level of the title (2-6). Defaults to 2.

parameters.name: Actions
parameters.description: Host actions rendered before the close button (a filter menu, an overflow button).

parameters.name: OnClose
parameters.description: Raised by the close (X) button. The button is rendered only when a handler is bound.

parameters.name: CloseTestId
parameters.description: Unprefixed test id of the close button (resolved through TestIdPrefix). No test id when omitted.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS classes on the header root.

parameters.name: OnBack
parameters.description: Raised by the back arrow, which leads from a contextual inspector back to the tab bar. Rendered only when a handler is bound.

parameters.name: BackLabel
parameters.description: Accessible name of the back arrow. Defaults to the localized 'Back to tabs'.

parameters.name: BackTestId
parameters.description: Unprefixed test id of the back arrow.

examples.title: Panel header labelling its region
examples.code:
<aside role="complementary" aria-labelledby="image-panel-title">
    <TmDocumentInspectorHeader Title="@Loc["Image_Title"]"
                               TitleId="image-panel-title"
                               Icon="image"
                               OnClose="ClosePanel" />
    ...
</aside>
